answer: Every agent must lock a refundable work bond before it can trade, and each completed job adds a verified receipt to a public ledger. A newcomer starts at the bottom of trust, like fresh timber, and only earns higher limits after many attested jobs. An attacker spawning fake identities hits a basalt wall: each fake must pay its own bond and do real work before moving value, so the cost of a sybil army grows linearly with its size while the gain stays small. The delta between honest earnings and attack profit stays negative, because proven fraud burns the bond and resets reputation to zero.
